item.label: Slides to Show
item.description: How many slides are visible at once. Lower this on tablet and phone for a better fit.

item.label: Slides to Scroll
item.description: How many slides move each time the carousel advances.

item.label: Gap Between Slides
item.description: Spacing between each slide.

item.label: Rows
item.description: Stack the slides in this many rows that scroll together, like a gallery wall. More than one row turns off the loop, Continuous Scroll and the effects.

item.label: Variable Slide Width
item.description: Give slides a set width instead of an equal share of the row. Set Image Height to let each slide take its image's own width.

item.label: Image Height
item.description: Gives every image this height. With Variable Slide Width each slide then takes its image's own width, so images of different sizes line up in one row; leave empty to use Slide Width. Otherwise every image is cropped to this height, so slides of different shapes line up evenly.

item.label: Slide Width
item.description: Fixed width used for each slide when Variable Slide Width is on.

item.label: Autoplay
item.description: Automatically advance the carousel.

item.label: Autoplay Style
item.description: Slide by Slide pauses on each slide. Continuous Scroll moves the slides at a steady speed without stopping, like a film strip. It loops on its own and hides the arrows and dots.

item.label: Scroll Speed
item.description: How far the slides travel each second, in pixels. 40 to 80 reads as a calm film strip.

item.label: Reverse Direction
item.description: Move the slides the other way: left to right, or top to bottom when vertical.

item.label: Autoplay Delay
item.description: How long each slide stays before advancing.

item.label: Transition Speed
item.description: How fast the slide animation plays.

item.label: Infinite Loop
item.description: Loop back to the first slide after the last one.

item.label: Pause on Hover
item.description: Stop the motion while the pointer is over the carousel. Keyboard focus inside the carousel always pauses it.

item.label: At the Last Slide
item.description: What happens after the last slide when Infinite Loop is off. Return to Start: autoplay goes back to the first slide. Return to Start, Arrows Too: the arrows and swiping also wrap around. Stop on the Last Slide: autoplay ends there.

item.label: Stop After Interaction
item.description: Stop autoplay for good once a visitor drags, clicks an arrow or dot, or uses the keyboard. The pause button starts it again.

item.label: Effect
item.description: How one slide gives way to the next. Fade, Cards, Flip and Cube show one slide at a time. Coverflow centers the active slide and tilts the others. Continuous Scroll needs Slide.

item.label: Coverflow Tilt
item.description: How far the side slides turn away.

item.label: Coverflow Depth
item.description: How far the side slides sit behind the active one.

item.label: Coverflow Spacing
item.description: Pull the side slides closer (negative) or push them apart (positive).

item.label: Slide Shadows
item.description: Shade the slides as they turn.

item.label: Drag / Swipe
item.description: Allow visitors to drag or swipe between slides.

item.label: Free Scroll
item.description: Drag or flick the slides and they glide to a stop with momentum, instead of moving one slide at a time.

item.label: Snap to Slides
item.description: After a free scroll, settle on the nearest slide edge.

item.label: Mouse Wheel
item.description: Scroll the slides with a trackpad or a horizontal mouse wheel. Scrolling up and down still scrolls the page.

item.label: Pinch to Zoom
item.description: Pinch or double-tap an image to zoom in, up to three times. On a computer, double-click.

item.label: Center Active Slide
item.description: Keep the active slide centered, with a peek of the slides on each side.

item.label: Vertical Direction
item.description: Slide up/down instead of left/right.

item.label: Show Arrows
item.description: Show the previous / next navigation arrows.

item.label: Show Dots
item.description: Show the pagination dots below the carousel.

item.label: Transition Easing
item.description: Easing curve for the slide animation.

item.label: Center Mode Style
item.description: Highlighted scales the active slide up and dims the rest.

item.label: Center Peek
item.description: How much of the neighbouring slides peeks in (classic center mode).

item.label: Arrow Layout
item.description: Overlay sits the arrows over the slides; Alongside places them side by side.

item.label: Center the Arrows
item.description: Place both arrows together at the horizontal center.

item.label: Draggable Scrollbar
item.description: Show a scrollbar under the slides that visitors can drag.

item.label: Pause Button
item.description: Show a pause and play button on the slides, so visitors can stop the motion.

item.label: Pause Button Position
item.description: Which corner of the slides the pause button sits in.

item.label: Autoplay Progress Bar
item.description: A thin bar along the bottom of the slides that fills until the next slide.

item.label: Show Thumbnails
item.description: Show a strip of small images under the carousel. Clicking one shows that slide, and the current slide is highlighted.

item.label: Thumbnails to Show
item.description: How many thumbnails fit across the strip.

item.label: Thumbnail Gap
item.description: Space between thumbnails.

item.label: Inactive Thumbnail Opacity
item.description: How faded the thumbnails other than the current slide look.

item.label: Thumbnail Spacing Top
item.description: Space between the carousel and the thumbnail strip.

item.label: Custom Cursor
item.description: Use a custom cursor when hovering the carousel.

item.label: Parallax Captions
item.description: Move each slide's title and caption a little slower than its image as the slides change.

item.label: Parallax Distance
item.description: How far the caption lags behind its image.

item.label: Arrow Corner Radius
item.description: Set to half the height/width for a circle.

item.label: Arrow Horizontal Offset
item.description: Move the arrows in or out from the carousel edges.

item.label: Active Dot Width
item.description: Optionally widen the active dot for a pill style.

item.label: Dots Spacing Top
item.description: Gap between the carousel and the dots.
